citation: Jiang, Pentelute, Collier & Zhou, "Atomic structure of anthrax protective antigen pore elucidates toxin translocation", Nature 521, 545 (2015), doi:10.1038/nature14247 (author manuscript PMC4519040; PDB 3J9C)
license: PMC author manuscript (not CC); facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
topic: The cryo-EM structure of the anthrax protective antigen (PA) pore at 2.9 A resolution shows the channel through which the enzymes lethal factor and edema factor cross the endosomal membrane.

facts.text: The mouth of the channel is 30 A wide at its opening and narrows to about 20 A inside; it can take secondary-structure elements but not folded domains such as the N-terminal domain of lethal factor.
Below the mouth, a ring of seven Phe427 side chains (the phi clamp) leaves a solvent-excluded hole of only 6 A, the narrowest point of the whole channel.
Below the clamp, the throat (about 18 A) and the tube formed by the 14-stranded beta barrel (inner diameter 12 to 18 A) are wide enough to hold an alpha helix.
Apart from the mouth and the lower end of the tube the channel wall has no openings, and mutating even one of the seven Phe427 residues severely reduces translocation.
facts.locator: Main text (translocation channel and phi-clamp paragraphs)

ask: Which description of how a substrate protein passes through this channel is consistent with all of these facts?

hypotheses.text: The substrate has to be fully unfolded to pass the phi clamp, and may form an alpha helix again in the wider throat and tube below it.
hypotheses.locator: Main text: the clamp may only allow passage of fully unfolded polypeptides; throat and tube can accommodate an alpha helix
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: Lethal factor passes through as an intact folded domain.
hypotheses.locator: Main text: the mouth cannot accommodate folded domains
hypotheses.reason: 孔口内径约 20 A，容不下折叠结构域，更过不了 6 A 的夹子。

hypotheses.text: The substrate passes the phi clamp as preformed alpha helices.
hypotheses.locator: Main text: the 6 A clamp is smaller than secondary-structure elements
hypotheses.reason: phi 夹只有 6 A，比 alpha 螺旋还窄。

hypotheses.text: The substrate has to stay fully extended along the whole channel, because no part of it is wide enough for a helix.
hypotheses.locator: Main text: the throat and tube (over 12 A) can hold an alpha helix
hypotheses.reason: 夹子下方的喉部与管道有 12–18 A，足以容纳 alpha 螺旋。
